### Proverbs
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/book-of-proverbs
Passage: Proverbs 26:1-28
Points:
- Old Testament wisdom literature presents diverse perspectives to help believers live skillfully before God.
- Proverbs uses general aphorisms that must be applied according to circumstances rather than absolute rules.
- Apparent tensions—such as whether to answer a fool or remain silent—require discerning the situation and the person.
- Believers must evaluate whether a foolish individual is teachable before deciding how to respond.
